description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thammennagama, Thambuththegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110053
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of multiple land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, and owners (primarily Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority and Pradeshiya Sabha), which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land registrations and property ownership matters.
